proofs.requirement: OA-RWY-012: for every runway of the kind build_runway makes (finite geometry within 1e9 m, axis within [-1, 1]) and every position and radius (any f64 bit pattern), occupies returns without panic, and for a known position the rotated coordinates are Some, finite and under 1e10 m in size; overflow and NaN of the result are not separately checked.

OA-AST-100: for every byte string of up to six octets, the big-endian reader and the slice taker either advance by exactly the requested width within the input or leave the position unchanged, and sign extension keeps the low bits within the signed range of the width.
OA-AST-104: the time of day converts to milliseconds and back to the same 24-bit count for every count, and neither conversion panics for any u32.
OA-AST-104: every six-octet aircraft identification that decodes encodes back to the same six octets.
OA-AST-106: for every 32-bit count at the CAT062 width, the longitude check accepts exactly the counts within plus or minus 2^25, and every count that converts gives a longitude within 180 degrees.
OA-AST-102: every item of the CAT048 UAP, walked over any bytes of up to 24 octets, ends past its start and within the input or is refused at an offset within the input.
OA-AST-101: the CAT021 field specification over any bytes of up to three octets ends past its start and within the input with at least one item, or is refused at an offset within the input.
OA-AST-101: the CAT048 field specification over any bytes of up to five octets ends past its start and within the input with at least one item, or is refused at an offset within the input.
OA-AST-101: the CAT062 field specification over any bytes of up to three octets ends past its start and within the input with at least one item, or is refused at an offset within the input.

OA-ADSB-100: every ADS-B v2 record of the fixed length decodes without panic, and a row it keeps has anomaly bits among the three that exist, a latitude and longitude within range, and a source that is absent, named or marked unknown.
OA-ADSB-100: every legacy ADS-B record of the fixed length decodes or is dropped without panic.

OA-ADSB-101: the payload header over any bytes of up to two records returns without panic, and a header it accepts gives the record length of its layout and a total length of exactly the header plus the counted records.

OA-ADSB-101: a payload with a valid ADS1 header and four all-zero legacy records, whatever the keep-or-drop outcome of each record, is accepted by the lenient and the strict decoder with consistent counts, and a strict refusal names a record inside the payload.

proofs.requirement: OA-MSAW-020: the straight-line altitude predicted at any time inside the look-ahead is finite for bounded altitude, rate and time.
OA-MSAW-021: `floor_of` plus `violates`: the floor is monotone in terrain and obstacle altitude (with or without a corridor surface), so a higher terrain or obstacle never removes a violation.
OA-MSAW-022: the time of a predicted violation is finite and inside its sample span for bounded altitude, rate, span and any computable floor (1,100,000 ft in magnitude).
OA-MSAW-043: the corridor floor is never below terrain or obstacle plus the approach clearance, and needs terrain and obstacle data.
OA-MSAW-059: the airport-area floor is never below terrain plus the area clearance, nor below the obstacle top plus the same clearance.

OA-MSAW-065: the classification msaw_plan switches on: an altitude older than the hold is lost (never judged), an unknown or fresh age is fresh, and an extrapolated altitude is never above the altitude. The plan-level property is a test.
OA-AST-102: bounded CAT021 item walking advances or refuses within the UAP table.
OA-AST-102: bounded CAT062 item walking advances or refuses within the UAP table.
OA-FEED-100: sequence and health counters saturate without overflow for reachable feed state.
OA-MATH-030: sine and cosine signs follow the quadrant and coordinate-sign rules.
OA-MATH-031: the fast magic-number rounding path agrees with half-even rounding on its bounded domain.
OA-MATH-032: the cut high and low components exactly reconstruct the normal input with bounded widths.
OA-RPL-101: accepted advances respect the tolerance or lone-feed gap limit and preserve clock consistency.
OA-RPL-100: a clock step requires the candidate sequence before a step is emitted.
OA-RPL-100: clock observation is total and a step obeys the confirmation count and state invariants.
